title: Protect the Academy! The Discipline Head's Struggle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Scandal at Tracen?! Not So Elite Now: Are
Students Lacking
Discipline?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, WHAAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The Bottomless Pit Claims Neighborhood
Restaurant as Next Victim!"
"Terrifying
Ghostly Streaks Revealed to be
High-Speed Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is the third time this month! But now
it's personal—what do they
mean we're
"lacking discipline?!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With more and more eyes on the
Umamusume racing scene, we've had
an
influx of tabloids trying to capitalize on
the boom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy increased campus
security and issued a warning to
all
students, so we haven't had any real
problems... Though that
hasn't stopped
the media.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The stuff they're complaining about was just a misunderstanding, but still... As the one leading the disciplinary committee, maybe I am too lax.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We can't have that! I'm gonna double
down on my disciplinary duties
and keep
Tracen safe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm the chair, so it's my responsibility to
fight off those vile tabloid
villains! And
fight I will!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! You're two seconds late to
campus! That'd be a huge time
loss on the
track, so speed it up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! Your skirt's a millimeter too
short!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
YOU THERE! Stay on your half of the
court! You can't steal the other
team's
space just 'cause they're on break!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Argh, it's almost curfew! There's so many
issues on campus, and so
little time to
solve them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nope, those small violations lead to bigger
ones! I'll have to nip them
all in the bud
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hang on. Why are those two leaving the dorm this late? That's dangerous, and it could lead to a real scandal! We've gotta catch them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! This arcade excursion violates
the Tracen Academy
disciplinary code!
Curfew applies to senior division too!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Yikes, the disciplinary chair?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now let's hurry and get back to the dorm!
If you've got time to waste
on
delinquency, you've got time to work on
your racing!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Like I don't work enough already! It's
always work, work, work... You
sound just
like my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: I have to run from dawn to dusk, and then they pile up ridiculous amounts of exercises to do on my days off... Is it such a crime to take a break?!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
And then we've got the disciplinary
committee nitpicking every stupid
little
thing... Being at Tracen is suffocating!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Su-suffocating?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... that's no excuse to violate the rules!
It doesn't matter what the
problem
is—delinquency isn't the answer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's my job to protect the rules.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now c'mon, we're leaving! As chair of the
disciplinary committee, I
can't let students
stay out this late!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thanks for the help. I'm so sorry
to have kept you past
curfew...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I upheld the disciplinary code
like I'm supposed to, but...
something
about that exchange felt wrong...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The stuff she said keeps echoing through
my head. I know it's no
excuse to be
off-campus at night, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sympathetic...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: I have to run from dawn to dusk, and then they pile up ridiculous amounts of exercises to do on my days off... Is it such a crime to take a break?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've been shouting at people
without hearing their side of the
story.
Both tonight... and earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now she's on track. I know Bamboo
believes that the rules are "good,"
but that
doesn't mean rule-breakers are inherently
"bad."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Talk first, huh? ...You're right! On behalf
of the committee, I'll try to
encourage
reform before demanding it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad you're here, Trainer! I never
know what I'm doing, but
you're always so
mature.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uraaaaah! I swear to you, I'll work hard to
keep learning and growing!
